Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Deputy Manager & Manager Posts - Complete Details

Exim Bank has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 08 vacancies, including Deputy Manager & Manager posts. The online application process will be conducted from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website, .eximbankindia.in.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15-09-2026
  • Application Last Date : 10-10-2026
  • Tentative Exam Month : November 2026
  • Last Day for Applying and Payment of Examination Fee : 10-10-2026
  • Tentative Month of Written Examination : November 2026*
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Female candidates : ₹100/- (Intimation charges)

Application Fee

  • Posts : Deputy Manager (JM I), Manager (MM II)
  • Application Start Date : 15-09-2026
  • Application Last Date : 10-10-2026
  • Last Day for Applying and Payment of Examination Fee : 10-10-2026
  • Position (Grade/Scale) : SC
  • Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) : 2
  • Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) : -
  • Position (Grade/Scale) : SC
  • Deputy Manager (Grade/Scale JM I) : 33
  • Manager (Grade/Scale MM II) : 35
  • Deputy Manager (Scale JM-I) : ₹48480 – 2000 – 62480 – 2340 – 67160 – 2680 – 85920
  • Manager (Scale MM-II) : ₹64820 – 2340 – 67160 – 2680 – 93960
  • OBC : ₹600/-
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Female candidates : ₹100/- (Intimation charges)
  • Name of Test : Section
  • Part II – Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions : 6 (of 8)
  • Mark Sheets, Degree Certificates, Experience/Relieving Letter, Caste Certificate (if applicable) : PDF format, 20–500 KB

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
